paths.title: Data Quality Pipelines
paths.description: Turn raw inputs into validated, traceable analytical datasets.
concept: Data quality is fitness for use
A dataset can be technically valid yet unsuitable because of coverage, timeliness, measurement, or selection problems.
Quality checks must reflect the analytical decision, not only generic rules such as non-null columns.
workflow: Transform raw data without losing provenance.
Every result should be rebuildable from immutable inputs and versioned logic.
Define the observation unit and schema.
Write the cleaned output and quality report.
question: Choose the strongest quality check
Which check best detects that temperatures were loaded in Fahrenheit instead of Celsius?
Count the rows
Validate units and plausible ranges
Sort column names alphabetically
Rename the file
Unit and domain-range validation detects values that may be numeric but semantically wrong.
checklist: Confirm that the final table supports the intended analysis.
A clean-looking table is not sufficient if its population or measurement process is misunderstood.
Source coverage matches the target population.
Units and time zones are normalized.

paths.title: Experimental and Causal Reasoning
paths.description: Separate prediction, association, and causal questions before choosing methods.
concept: Descriptive, predictive, and causal analyses require different evidence and evaluation.
A high-performing predictor does not prove an intervention will change an outcome.
workflow: Define decisions and outcomes before observing treatment results.
Pre-specified rules reduce selective reporting and ambiguous interpretation.
Define the unit of assignment and analysis.
question: Identify a causal design advantage
Why does random assignment strengthen a causal conclusion?
It guarantees a large effect
It tends to balance causes across groups
It removes all missing data
It makes charts unnecessary
Random assignment makes treatment independent of plausible confounders in expectation.
checklist: Challenge the assumptions behind an intervention conclusion.
Causal language should match the assignment mechanism and analysis.
Primary and exploratory outcomes are separated.

paths.title: Reproducible Analysis Delivery
paths.description: Package data, code, environment, outputs, and limitations into an auditable result.
concept: An analysis is reproducible when defined inputs and code regenerate the reported outputs in a controlled environment.
Notebooks alone are insufficient when hidden state, manual edits, or unpinned dependencies affect the result.
workflow: Make every transformation and output traceable.
A reviewer should distinguish source data, intermediate artifacts, and final reports.
Separate raw, intermediate, and output directories.
question: Remove hidden notebook state
Which action best tests whether a notebook is reproducible?
Change its font
Restart the kernel and run all cells in order
Add more markdown colors
Copy only the final chart
A clean restart reveals dependencies on variables or execution order that were not captured explicitly.
checklist: Confirm that another analyst can regenerate and inspect the work.
A trustworthy handoff includes the result and the evidence chain that produced it.
One command or sequence rebuilds outputs.
